title: A Sentinel-2 COG as data

dataset.name: Sentinel-2 L2A true colour COG, tile 55GEN (UTM 55S), sentinel-cogs on AWS

right.label: cell: gridlook
right.note: gridlook can import a WGS84 GeoTIFF as an overlay texture (v1.4) but it cannot read a projected COG as a data array, so there is nothing to load here.

gap: gridlook's readers are Zarr, Icechunk and NetCDF; a COG in a projected CRS is not a dataset to it.
bridge: A virtual Zarr or Icechunk view over the COG, built from the chunk byte references that gdal mdim get-refs / blocklist already produce, so gridlook reads the same bytes through zarrita.
